colonies_tested.quote: From every gene deletion experiment, four or eight KmR colonies were chosen and checked for ones with the correct structure by PCR

lb.quote: Cells were routinely grown in LB medium containing 1% Bacto Tryptone (Difco), 0.5% yeast extract (Difco), and 0.5% NaCl

scoring_rule.quote: Mutants were scored as correct if two or more colonies had the expected structure based on PCR tests for both junction fragments.

secm.quote: The exceptional case, secM, has a translational arrest sequence

selection.quote: Our standard protocol usually yielded 10–1000 KmR colonies when cells were incubated aerobically at 37°C on Luria broth (LB) agar containing 30 μg/ml kanamycin.

strain.quote: The Keio collection is comprised of 3985 deletions in duplicate (7970 total) of E. coli K-12 strain BW25113

table_6.quote: Essential gene candidates are given in Supplementary Table 6.

caveats.quote: Because genetic footprinting measures cell populations, a mutation causing slow growth can lead to under-representation of the mutant and hence false classification of many genes as essential. In contrast, we sought deletion mutants as survivors without regard to growth rate.
caveats.value: a recovery method does not call a slow grower essential
